problem: BB-P009 validated a local HTML5 persistence contract, but production code still lacks the storage service boundary, A/B recovery journal, protected corrupt-load path, size gate, migration fixture and real-browser reload probe required to implement it.

decision.rationale: Implement the validated BB-P009 protocol directly: semantic storage service, stable Defold application id, two alternating generations, protected load, monotonic generation selection, pre-write size checks and mandatory readback before success.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-game competitor comparison is not applicable to an engine persistence/recovery implementation; the governing evidence is the already-validated BB-P009 technical contract plus current Defold documentation.
research.reference_exception: No player-facing interaction or visual-quality decision is made by this storage harness ticket.

anti_pattern.observation: A single unprotected save/load path can raise on corrupt data and a single-file replacement can leave no prior valid generation to recover.
anti_pattern.lesson: Protect load operations and preserve a previous validated generation until a new generation passes readback validation.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Defold documents sys.get_save_file/sys.save/sys.load for persisted tables, notes that missing files load as an empty table and corrupt/unsupported data may raise, and documents HTML5 persistence through the browser virtual filesystem/IndexedDB.
The sys API documents sys.get_save_file as the platform save-path API and a 512 KiB serialized output ceiling; BeBee keeps stricter 128 KiB warning and 256 KiB release gates.
HTML5 filesystem persistence can be asynchronous relative to the game write call, so success is reported as accepted_local_pending_browser_persistence rather than immediate durable confirmation.

alternatives.reason: Preserves a prior valid generation through failed writes/readback and matches the validated BB-P009 recovery protocol without wall-clock ordering.
Can replace the only valid save before the new bytes are proven readable.
Wall-clock ordering is unnecessary and less deterministic than an explicit monotonic generation counter.
Turns reads into implicit writes and destroys corrupt-peer evidence; repair is deferred to the next explicit successful save.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Gameplay-facing persistence is behind a service exposing load/save/has/delete and does not require direct sys calls.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: systems/storage/storage_service.lua composes the local adapter and Defold backend; all journal behavior lives below the semantic boundary.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A/B selection preserves the previous highest valid generation until the new target passes readback verification.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: adapters/storage/local_adapter.lua targets missing/invalid/lower generation, validates the readback canonical envelope and tests forced write/readback failures against the retained prior generation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Corruption, migration, size-budget and storage-unavailable paths are explicit and non-throwing at the service boundary.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Defold backend wraps save-path/load/save access, migrations advance sequentially, local adapter enforces size diagnostics/gates, and tests/test_storage.lua covers recovery/failure cases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The implementation includes a development-only HTML5 probe for reload, immediate refresh, browser close/reopen and corruption, with an explicit release-negative assertion.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: app/storage_probe.lua and tools/visual_qa/storage_html5_smoke.py implement the browser-level proof surface; workflow execution and retained artifacts are intentionally isolated to the BB-007 process follow-up before ticket closeout.

automated: Test and data runs the adversarial storage suite on the exact PR head.
Existing HTML5 CI builds/smokes the modified bootstrap and release bundle on the exact PR head.
A separate process PR will run storage_html5_smoke.py against exact-source development/release bundles and retain the report.
verification.runtime_errors: No retained browser-persistence success is claimed by this harness manifest until exact-head CI executes the storage smoke; service-level failure paths return structured results rather than throwing into gameplay code.
verification.save_data_impact: Introduces format_version=1, save_version=1 A/B local save slots under stable application id com.strayforest.bebee. No prior public save exists; migration fixture covers save_version 0 to 1.

known_limitations: Portal private/incognito behavior remains the separate P0/P8 platform case defined by BB-P009.
Cloud save/account synchronization is intentionally not implemented by BB-007.
CI workflow execution of the browser persistence smoke is isolated into a separate process PR to preserve the governance trust boundary.
